{{Quote|Commander Skywalker, almost all the gun platforms are destroyed, and only&hellip; wait, what's that&hellip;?|The pilot to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="CW10" />}}
A '''clone trooper pilot''' flew with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], participating in the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]] as a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] under [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="CW10" />

During the battle, the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] reported to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Skywalker that nearly all of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan's]] [[InterGalactic Banking Clan gun platform/Legends|gun platforms]] had been destroyed. However, his report was interrupted by the arrival of a [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|''Ginivex''-class starfighter]] piloted by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] and the rest of his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]].<ref name="CW10" />
